author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to transcribe audio to text using ChatGPT. In this step-by-step tutorial, I show you how to upload an audio recording, generate a transcript, turn it into an interactive business dashboard, and copy the text into Word or Google Docs. We also cover why you should review AI transcripts against the original recording. Audio uploads currently require a paid ChatGPT plan; availability can vary by account and workspace.

Host: Kevin Stratvert
